source_instruction: i am looking for a individual wrapped birthday cakes and chocolate chip blondies that come in a 12 pack.
query: Ugh, my neighbor’s cat keeps sneaking onto my back porch to knock over the potted mint I’ve been trying to grow for iced tea all summer, and the grocery store’s self-checkout line was so backed up when I walked in I almost turned around to leave, plus I just remembered I forgot to pick up my dry cleaning on the way over and the shop closes in 45 minutes. I’ve heard that the individually wrapped treats in the birthday cake and chocolate chip blondie flavors are really popular for the potluck I’m going to next weekend, and that none of the options I was looking at run over $60 total.
